data.title: TTFT / TPS
data.tagline: Measures of time to first output and of token generation speed after output begins
data.learningOutcome: You can read a timeline and separate TTFT, TPS, and total duration.
data.description: TTFT measures time from sending a request to receiving the first token. TPS measures tokens produced each second afterward. A quick first token does not guarantee a short total response time.

learning.assumes: You have experienced a chat answer that waits, then appears in pieces.
learning.outcome: You can read a timeline and separate TTFT, TPS, and total duration.

explanation.title: Wait for TTFT
explanation.text: TTFT runs from send to the first text token.

explanation.title: Then watch TPS
explanation.text: TPS is tokens per second after generation begins, not transactions per second.

explanation.title: Then measure total time
explanation.text: A longer answer can still take longer to finish even when it begins quickly.

data.boundary: A short TTFT does not mean a fast full response; generation speed and output length still matter.

lessonPractice.title: Model A shows its first token in one second but generates slowly; Model B starts in three seconds and finishes quickly. How should speed be compared?

options.label: Measure time to first content, generation rate after start, and total completion separately
options.feedback: TTFT, TPS, and total time describe different phases and together explain the two experiences.

options.label: Compare only which model shows the first character and call it faster overall
options.feedback: Short first-content wait does not imply fast generation, and a long answer may finish later.

options.label: Combine network waiting and generation into one TPS number without phases
options.feedback: TPS describes output rate after generation starts, so including prior waiting removes its meaning.

data.agentPrompt: Measure TTFT, TPS after output begins, and total completion separately under the same model settings and answer target. Do not replace full comparison with feels instant, and record network, queue, and generation phases.
